context_rule: hasContext may be true only when the selected response path has real evidence, a protected knowledge block, or non-empty governed results. Any no-context servedBy value forces hasContext=false.
version_rule: The public version is v35.1.1. The v35.0 protocolometry connector is an explicit internal base and must never be presented as the public release version.
greeting_rule: Bounded Macedonian and English greetings return a direct institutional greeting without AI Search, Workers AI, Anthropic, or knowledge retrieval.
safety_boundary: This consistency package changes the response contract and safe entrypoint only. It performs no deployment, route change, custom-domain change, binding change, secret change, or frontend migration.
